sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा महा तेजाः पाणिना स ममार्ज ताम् ।तम् आलभ्य ततः स्वस्ति इति उक्त्वा तपसे ययौ ॥१-४६-७॥
transliteration: evam uktvā mahā tejāḥ pāṇinā sa mamārja tām ।tam ālabhya tataḥ svasti iti uktvā tapase yayau ॥1-46-7॥

translations.english: Highly brilliant Kasyapa, having thus spoken, touched her gently with his palm, stroked her body and said, "May good betide thee". Having said this, Kasyapa went away to perform austerities.
